subject: GCP Private Offer — one-time credit & marketplace margin carveout (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Amelia Shore <amelia@cloudreach.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-team@cloudreach.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer: CloudReach (GCP) — request for onboarding credit + revenue share clarification

Hi Rafael / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked solid and the technical team is aligned. Procurement asked me to confirm two items before we move to PO:

1) One-time onboarding credit: CloudReach is requesting a one-time $75k onboarding credit tied to the first invoice to offset migration costs.
2) Marketplace rev-share & billing cadence: They want the private offer to reflect a 10% rev-share to the marketplace for year one (we typically publish 20%) and prefer Net-60 payment terms.

They understand these are non-standard asks and asked if we can escalate for an exec OK. We’re also attaching their updated PO (attached).

Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can make a concession on the credit/rev-share?

Cheers,
Amelia
Amelia Shore
Head of Strategic Alliances — CloudReach
[Attachment: CloudReach_PO_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer: CloudReach (GCP) — request for onboarding credit + revenue share clarification

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding CloudReach request. Quick context:

- ARR profile: ~$1.2M ARR first 12 months with >60% growth target Y2.
- Standard marketplace rev-share: 20% (Redwood policy) — customer asked for 10% for Y1 only.
- One-time credit: $75k (we typically do success credits but rarely upfront one-time credits at this magnitude).
- Payment: Customer asked Net-60 and marketplace prefers Net-30 settlement to reseller (billing implications).

Questions for deal desk/executive approval:
A) Approve one-time onboarding credit $75k (cold credit applied to first invoice)?
B) Allow reduced marketplace rev-share to 10% for first 12 months?
C) Accept Net-60 customer terms while ensuring Redwood receives Net-30 from marketplace / or take a short-term float?

Attachments: PO, offer summary, marketplace term comparison.

I recommend we consider a conditional approval: reduce rev-share to 12.5% for Y1 and provide a $50k onboarding credit contingent on a 24-month commitment and 60% usage threshold in Q1. If we accept Net-60, we should ask for an early payment clause or a small financing fee.

Marking this as an exec-approval ask — Marissa, can you weigh in? Karthik, please confirm legal/marketplace gating items.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: GCP-Private-Offer-Summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer: CloudReach (GCP) — request for onboarding credit + revenue share clarification

Rafael — good summary. A few notes from pricing/finance: 

- $75k credit is material vs. expected first-year gross margin on this account. We need clear guardrails (term, usage minimums, clawback).
- Marketplace rev-share reduction to 10% will reduce partner-fee expense but also changes how we record take-rate. We need marketplace legal signoff (Jonas), and procurement operational feasibility (Karthik).
- Net-60: finance will accept if we add a 1.5% uplift for any settlement beyond Net-30 to offset float; or require a signed early-pay guarantee from the marketplace reseller (AWS Marketplace).

Can we present exec with 2 options to approve quickly?

Option 1 (Preferred): $50k one-time onboarding credit + rev-share 12.5% for Year 1 + 24-month commitment + usage thresholds (60% target Q1), Redwood receives Net-30 or 1.5% uplift for Net-60.
Option 2: No upfront credit; instead offer $75k credit split into milestone-based credits (25k on go-live, 25k at 3 months usage, 25k at 6 months) + rev-share 15% Y1.

If exec wants faster signoff we can recommend Option 1 with clawback language.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Deal Desk & GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Marketplace-Terms-Comparison.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer: CloudReach (GCP) — request for onboarding credit + revenue share clarification

Quick legal/marketplace notes:

- AWS Marketplace governance allows for publisher discounts but changes must be registered and verified; reduced rev-share requires Marketplace Ops (cc'd) approval and may take 3–5 business days to enact for a private offer. We should not promise a rev-share change to the customer until ops confirms.
- Clawback/credit schedule: milestone credits are better — easier to recover if usage/commitment not met.
- Payment cadence: if Redwood is paid by AWS after marketplace settlement, we will likely be on Net-30; asking the marketplace to pay us Net-30 while they collect Net-60 from the customer is atypical. 

Action items for exec note:
1) Approve Option 1 (conditional) or Option 2 (milestone credits)
2) Allow Legal to finalize clawback language and ask Marketplace Ops to confirm rev-share change feasibility
3) Approve 1.5% finance uplift for Net-60 (if marketplace won't give us Net-30)

Jonas — can you ping Marketplace Ops and get an initial feasibility read?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk & Legal — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer: CloudReach (GCP) — request for onboarding credit + revenue share clarification

Thanks team — executive decision: APPROVE Option 1 (conditional) with the following firm guardrails:

- Onboarding credit: $50,000 one-time, applied on first invoice. Clawback: full pro-rata repayment if annual committed ARR < 80% of forecast at 12 months.
- Rev-share: 12.5% to marketplace for Year 1 only; revert to standard 20% in Year 2 (must be documented with Marketplace Ops).
- Commitment: 24-month contract term with minimum annual usage target (60% of forecast in Q1).
- Payments: Redwood to be paid Net-30 by marketplace; if marketplace cannot do Net-30, a 1.5% uplift will be charged to CloudReach to offset float.

Marissa has approved this on behalf of Deal Desk and Finance. Legal to finalize language and Marketplace Ops to confirm technical feasibility and timeline. Rafael — please update the customer and request an exec-level signature on the PO reflecting these conditions.

Marissa Cole
VP, Deal Desk & GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
